items.title: Everything in my life and career changed here ⤵️ Back in 2020 something clicked
items.summary:
Everything in my life and career changed here ⤵️

Back in 2020 something clicked. 💥

it started internally before the external could meet me. 

💥Because how you think, influences how you feel, which influences your actions, which influences your eventual results 

These mindset changes shifted my worldview ⤵️

1️⃣I stopped comparing myself to other YouTubers, content creators and people who were more successful and popular than me. 

I think a lot of people think I’m naturally super self-confident 🤭 

I actually *built* this mindset. 

✍️Years of journaling and rewriting my limiting beliefs about myself (“i’m not likeable” “I’m too intense” “I’m too much” “I’m annoying” “I’m cringe”) followed by years of daily Neural reprogramming and subconscious hypnosis work through To Be Magnetic, and to this day I’m constantly checking myself when a limiting thought pops in. I still journal every single day. 

The work never stops but daaang does it get easier. My beliefs about myself and how life gets to work for me are so locked in than I usually never have to think about my worth, what I deserve, what is possible for me anymore. 

But the work did that. I built that. It didn’t come naturally. 

2️⃣I started to see the magic within myself so fully that I then started to see the magic within others. 

There’s no comparison. no competition. 

Because I am infinite. 

I am already whole and magical myself. There’s so much love within me that it effortlessly pours into everyone around me without even thinking about it. 

I give generously, I share openly, I cheer everyone on because I see their magic too. 

This open-hearted energy is so magnetic. 

Giving is FUN! Loving is fun! Sharing is fun!

Living in that energy all the time not only gives you the most insanely magic light-filled Aura (where you start lighting up every room you walk into and everyone else starts catching that energy too) but it creates an abundant life. 

⤵️

step into your next level and find your community of kindred spirits who want to see you succeed and shine in-person

items.title: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio in Birth Charts
items.summary:
A detailed exploration of what Venus retrograde in Scorpio means in birth charts, primarily by looking through 29 different celebrity case studies, with astrologers Skye Barclay and Chris Brennan.

During the episode, we examine not only how this placement manifests natally, but what happened when these figures experienced their 8-year Venus retrograde recurrences. By tracing these transits, we highlight the major turning points, delayed successes, and public reckonings that literally played out in their lives and careers in real time.

Our research uncovered some profound archetypal patterns surrounding what it means for a retrograde planet to be in its detriment. We dive deep into concepts like "struggle love," the "sympathetic villain," and the myths of Medusa and Lucifer, exploring how the individuals in our case studies challenged conventional beauty standards, subverted gender norms, and navigated the darker, more taboo facets of Venus.

Skye is the author of an awesome new book titled 2026 Venus Retrograde: A Dance of Daggers & Delights, which you can get in print or PDF on her website: 

https://www.skyeastrology.com/venusrx

This is episode 552 of The Astrology Podcast.
